outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Command result with returncode, stdout, stderr

operations.name: decode
operations.description: Decode an APK into a source/resource tree (apktool d).

inputs.name: apk_path
inputs.description: Path to the APK file to decode.

inputs.name: output_dir
inputs.description: Directory to write the decoded tree to. Surfaced as a node output so downstream nodes can reference it via $nodes.<id>.outputs.output_dir.

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: Force overwrite of existing output directory.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Command result with returncode, stdout, stderr.

operations.name: build
operations.description: Build an APK from a decoded source tree (apktool b).

inputs.name: source_dir
inputs.description: Path to the decoded source directory.

inputs.name: output_apk
inputs.description: Path to write the built APK to. Surfaced as a node output so downstream nodes can reference it via $nodes.<id>.outputs.output_apk.

inputs.name: use_aapt1
inputs.description: Use aapt1 instead of aapt2 for resource linking (helps when aapt2 fails on framework resources like Theme.Holo, android:color/transparent).

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Command result with returncode, stdout, stderr.
